title: ODR source review and Alpha receiving

task.name: Install and operate the original ODR source and Alpha review workspace
task.purpose: Give the original team its complete source-selected review application, durable original handover, exact revisions and an independently received working installation.
task.request: Continue the original selected Workshare and Installation with complete application source, original workspace, actual runtimes and named owners. Operate the original review/measurement/native-request history and deliver whole editable source/state.
task.completeOutput: Complete original source and license; immutable source editions; selected Python/Node; managed original UI with explicit durable saves; complete handover/report; whole installation ZIP; independently received managed application and onward edit/export.
task.repeatTrigger: A substantive new source, notification edition, review, measurement or actual native response continues through the same original application. Retain all earlier source/record history and explicit receiving identities.
task.pricedUnit: Use the original complete Workshare, source permissions, funded/commercial assignments and actual authorised budget. Original source, service and Stellar operations remain within that same unit.

source.reference: Original selected Workshare and Customer Installation seed; complete APPLICATION_SOURCE.json and original handover; products/odr-workspace/SCF.md and native/API.md.
source.population: Complete source publications, notification definitions and drafts, exact historical reviews, planned/observed Alpha measurements, actual selected metadata/mappings and exact prepared request/received response records.
source.meaning: Preserve actual source account, record/workspace identity, full history, explicit technical findings, selected original metadata and native response identity. Separate authored planning from observed evidence.
source.changePolicy: Original owners select new publications or application editions and review new draft revisions. Preserve prior editions and complete native request/response lineage; no automatic tenant dispatch or inference of required fields.

receiving.application: The complete selected original source app through products/odr-workspace, fifteen merchant_odr tools, the direct-child ODR review Application and original Installation seed.
receiving.acceptanceRule: Receive complete original source and handover; verify workspace/source/digests. Open the managed original UI, review real selected fields and records, retain an ordinary edit with explicit installed save, reopen and inspect full history. Receive a lost response under the same input; retain conflicts for explicit receiving. Stop before whole snapshot; independently receive all original source/history/lineage, reopen the received app and save/export onward.
receiving.changeAndWithdraw: Keep original source, service and customer decisions with their existing owners. Preserve earlier source and record history. No live Dataverse write is implied by offline request preparation.
receiving.recovery: Retain exact lifecycle UUID/input and full browser pending payload/expected digest. Complete committed transitions before requiring temporary donor paths; verify surviving inputs. Independent receiving keeps workspace UUID and assigns a new installation identity.
receiving.maintenance: Name original source/product owner, staff operator, receiving operator and commercial owner. Retain selected runtime/source, whole archive and actual original results with the same case.

steps.title: Select original scope and source
steps.result: Keep the complete original Workshare, attached source, saved workspace and acceptance checks.

steps.title: Prepare the whole selected application
steps.result: Verify every source member, builder and license; receive the actual original handover and immutable source lineage.

steps.title: Open the managed original service
steps.result: Review the exact selected installation, Python/Node/source and direct child readiness.

steps.title: Operate complete original review
steps.result: Retain exact source/notification/review editions, meaningful Alpha evidence and complete prepared/received native records.

steps.title: Save and reconcile original work
steps.result: Explicitly save the whole handover, receive the same exact pending payload after interruption, and preserve both editions on a real CAS conflict.

steps.title: Export source and workspace
steps.result: Stop the application; export original full handover, report and source then whole installation ZIP.

steps.title: Independently receive
steps.result: Verify every archive member, preserve workspace/history/source and sender lineage, and create a separate installation UUID.

steps.title: Reopen and deliver onward
steps.result: Operate the received original application, preserve an ordinary original record edit and export complete onward artifacts.
